required_status_checks.name: Lint workflows
required_status_checks.when: Pull requests that touch `.github/workflows/**` or workflow lint scripts.

recommended_rules.setting: Require a pull request before merging

recommended_rules.value: **CI required** always; **Lint workflows** when workflow files change

recommended_rules.setting: Require branches to be up to date
recommended_rules.value: enabled (recommended after first protected test PR passes)

maintainer_bypass_policy: Organization or repository admins may bypass required checks only for documented emergencies. Record the reason, actor, and follow-up pull request in the M0 milestone completion comment.

verification_record.notes: Fill after manual configuration. Do not enable required checks until M0-08 merge proves **CI required** on `main`.
